doc: COSTGUARD-1: D1 budgets the tick Worker samples hourly (seed/worker/src/costsample.js). Ultrastable runs on its own Cloudflare account (81e3a4ef..., free plan: 5 million D1 rows read a day across the account, 10,000 Workers AI neurons a day). The hourly caps below add up to about 4.1 million rows a day, under the free allowance. READ-BUDGET-1 (2026-11-16): the account hit its daily read limit by 08:00 UTC that day; the quniverse database this file used to budget is not Ultrastable's and is no longer sampled (no overlap with the Quniverse).

budgets.note: 2026-11-15 read 1.72M rows in the day; READ-BUDGET-1 indexes (migration 0016) target under 1M.
2026-11-16 read 4.33M rows by 08:00 UTC, almost all analytics scans of hits; analytics 0.2.0 bounds them.
